- No frameworks.

Create a visually striking cinematic museum-night website.

- luxury museum after dark
- velvet darkness
- golden spotlights
- quiet mystery

- premium cultural event

- dark velvet / near-black background

import re
p = "website_museum_ollama-qwen3.8-flash-next-125b-a6b-q4_01.html"
src = open(p, encoding="utf-8").read()
print("size:", len(src), "lines:", src.count("\n")+1)

checks = {
 "title": "ARTIFACT: Museum Night" in src,
 "meta description": 'name="description"' in src,
 "og:title": 'property="og:title"' in src,
 "og:description": 'property="og:description"' in src,
 "og:image": 'property="og:image"' in src,
 "favicon data uri": 'rel="icon"' in src and "data:image/svg+xml" in src,
 "hero headline": "Museum Night, Reimagined" in src,
 "hero img": "source.unsplash.com/featured/2400x1400?museum,night" in src,
 "date badge": "18 October 2026" in src,
 "navbar links": all(x in src for x in ["#program","#artists","#venue","#tickets","#faq"]),
 "get tickets cta": "Get Tickets" in src,
 "save to calendar": "Save to Calendar" in src,
 "timeline times": all(t in src for t in ["19:00","19:30","20:00","21:00","22:00","23:00","00:00","01:00"]),
 "8 artist imgs": len(re.findall(r"source\.unsplash\.com/featured/1200x900", src)) >= 8,
 "svg map": "<svg" in src and ("metro" in src.lower() or 'M</text>' in src),
 "ticket prices": all(x in src for x in ["29","59","129"]),
 "recommended badge": "Recommended" in src,
 "ics content": "BEGIN:VCALENDAR" in src and "20261018T190000" in src and "20261019T020000" in src and "artifact-museum-night.ics" in src,
 "ics blob": "Blob" in src and "createObjectURL" in src,
 "faq 6 items": src.count("aria-expanded") >= 6,
 "newsletter": 'type="email"' in src,
 "toast": "showToast" in src,
 "modal": 'aria-modal' in src and "Escape" in src,
 "demo note": "no real ticket purchase" in src.lower() or "no real payment" in src.lower(),
 "intersectionobserver": "IntersectionObserver" in src,
 "scroll-behavior": "scroll-behavior" in src,
 "reduced motion": "prefers-reduced-motion" in src,
 "palette": all(c in src for c in ["#070506","#1a0710","#3a0f1d","#07111f","#d6ad60","#f3d79b","#f8efe2","#b9a999"]),
 "grain noise": "feTurbulence" in src,
 "no external scripts": len(re.findall(r'<script[^>]+src=', src)) == 0,
 "no external css": len(re.findall(r'<link[^>]+stylesheet', src)) == 0,
}
for k,v in checks.items(): print(("OK " if v else "MISS"), k)

# extract inline JS
m = re.search(r"<script>(.*?)</script>", src, re.S)
open("_inline.js","w",encoding="utf-8").write(m.group(1) if m else "")
print("inline js chars:", len(m.group(1)) if m else 0)
"}
